long_biography.plain_text:
Redeveloping the former Quincy Medical Center placed Jason Ward at the centre of a long public planning process. Representing FoxRock Properties, he opened dialogue with neighbours and worked with consultants, designers and municipal officials on a plan attentive to site history, connected green space and new housing.

Ward's work combines acquisition with hands-on redevelopment and continued property management. Earlier, FoxRock transformed industrial space into an accessible school; its subsequent expansion outside Boston paired market selection with local partners. Across those projects, Ward's contribution has been operational: moving from opportunity and planning to buildings adapted for the people who use them.

uncertainties: No dedicated Forbes profile for the target was found. Forbes results for an Industrial Search Partners principal, a Northstar commodity analyst and a Los Angeles photographer are unrelated namesakes and were excluded.

Jason Ward is a highly common name. The identity is resolved only through the combined Abbentures entity name, matching Quincy business address, Fox Rock management connection and Ward's official FoxRock biography; no single name-only result was accepted.

USCG identifies Abbentures Benetti LLC as vessel operator, not Jason Ward personally. The vessel and corporate records are used only to disambiguate the immutable owner record and do not appear in either biography.

FoxRock's official biography calls Ward CEO and co-founder, while other current and historical sources call him managing director, managing partner or manager. CEO is used as the current first-party title; the earlier titles support continuity of the same executive identity.

FoxRock's own profile identifies Rob Hale as founding owner, and trade coverage likewise distinguishes Hale as owner from Ward's management role. Ward's equity, founding capital and personal ownership of FoxRock or its projects are not publicly disclosed.

FoxRock, Fox Rock Capital, project-company assets, portfolio size, transaction values and property interests are institutional or Hale-family-office facts. None are aggregated into Ward's personal wealth or treated as his personal property.

Because no reliable evidence establishes Ward's personal wealth mechanism or asset base, all four wealth classifications remain supported Unknowns. His documented co-founder and executive occupation is not used as a proxy for a personal real-estate fortune.

The immutable record's existing American nationality, United States birth country and 1970 birth year were not independently corroborated. No correction is proposed, and the biographies avoid birth details.
No reliable source established a middle name, secondary nationality, place or full date of birth, name suffix or secondary residence.

No personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website met the direct-identity threshold. The official FoxRock biography is proposed only as a Company Website, not a personal social profile.
